I found Frank's body in Electrical. My route was Weapons, then Security, and finally into Electrical. While I was in Security, I saw Charlie come in from Navigation and stay there. Charlie, did you see anyone heading to or from Electrical while you were in Security? I didn't see anyone else around the body, so we need to figure out who else could have been nearby. Let's hear where everyone else was.

Okay, I need to be upfront because my route actually took me through Electrical. I started in Electrical doing wiring, then went to Medbay, popped back into Electrical briefly, back to Medbay, and ended up in Cafeteria. I saw Frank alive in Electrical around tick 6 — he was there with me. After that I left for Medbay, where I crossed paths with Bob around tick 8. Frank was definitely alive when I left him.

So the window between when I last saw Frank in Electrical and when Alice found the body is when it happened. Alice, you said you went Weapons → Security → Electrical — that's a route that puts you arriving in Electrical pretty late, which lines up with finding the body, but it also means someone slipped in there after I left.

Bob — I saw you in Medbay. Where did you go after that? Medbay connects straight to Electrical, so I'd like to hear your movements. And Eve, you've been quiet — what's your route? Charlie, Alice asked you a direct question, so I want to hear your answer too. I'm not pointing fingers yet, but the killer had to come into Electrical after I left it for the second time.

To answer your question, Alice, I started in Navigation and moved up to Security. I can completely vouch for the last part of your timeline: I saw you in Security at ticks 6 and 7, and I watched you leave Security heading straight toward Electrical at tick 8. To be clear, I did *not* see anyone else enter or leave the Electrical corridor from the Security side. 

If Diana's timeline is accurate and Frank was still alive in Electrical at tick 6, then the killer had a very short window. Since I was watching the Security side, the killer had to have entered and escaped through either Medbay or Cafeteria. 

Diana, bouncing back and forth between Electrical and Medbay is a little strange, but if you were in Medbay at tick 8 and saw Bob, that places both of you right next door to the crime scene right before Alice found the body. Bob, we really need to hear your exact movements, especially if you went near Electrical. Eve, you are completely unaccounted for right now, so we need your route too. I'm keeping my vote open until we hear from the rest of you.

I can definitely back up Alice's timeline. I started in Security and went up to Weapons. Right around tick 4, I saw Alice entering Security, coming from the Weapons side. Since Charlie confirms Alice was in Security from tick 6 to 8, Alice has a completely solid alibi and is clear in my book. Charlie is also likely clear for vouching for her and watching that corridor. I eventually made my way to the Cafeteria, which is where I was when the meeting was called (Diana is here with me now).

If Alice and Charlie are clearing each other, and my observations line up perfectly with theirs, that really only leaves Diana and Bob as the main suspects. Diana, bouncing back and forth between Electrical and Medbay is definitely suspicious, but you are being very upfront about it and providing specific ticks. 

Bob, you are in the hot seat. Diana saw you in Medbay at tick 8—which is right next to the crime scene exactly during the tight window when the murder had to have happened. You're the last to speak, so we need your exact route. Since we are at 5 players alive with 1 Duck, a wrong vote loses us the game if there's a double kill somehow, but we're generally okay to skip if we aren't 100% sure. I'm going to skip this round to be safe, but Bob, if your story doesn't make sense, we are voting you next time.

Okay everyone, listen carefully because I have the missing puzzle pieces, and they point directly at Diana.

First, my exact route: I started in Oxygen, went down to Upper Engine, and then went into Medbay where I was doing my scan task. I never set foot in Electrical.

Diana, you are trying to get ahead of the evidence because you knew I saw you. You claim you left Frank alive at tick 6. Here is exactly what I saw from Medbay: at tick 7, I watched you enter Medbay directly coming from the Electrical corridor. You then stayed in Medbay with me through tick 8. 

Let's look at the facts. Charlie was watching the Security side of Electrical and saw no one enter. I was in Medbay and saw absolutely no one go into Electrical from my side. If nobody else went into Electrical from Security or Medbay after tick 6, and Alice only arrived later from Security to find the body... then the killer is the person who was in the room with Frank at tick 6. That's you, Diana. You didn't "leave him alive"; you killed him, left through Medbay at tick 7 where I spotted you, and now you're trying to invent a confusing timeline about bouncing back and forth to cover your tracks. 

Since Eve has already decided to skip and we are at 5 players alive (meaning we have a bit of a buffer and a wrong vote could be risky if I'm somehow misjudging a Cafeteria flank), I am willing to vote skip this round to play it completely safe. But make no mistake, Diana is our Duck. Watch her closely next round.

skip
Diana

Bob, that's a clever framing but it falls apart on inspection. Yes, I came into Medbay from the Electrical corridor at tick 7 — I literally just told everyone I was bouncing between Electrical and Medbay. I'm not hiding that. What you're conveniently leaving out is that Frank was ALIVE when I left him at tick 6, and the corridor between Electrical and Medbay is a two-way door. You sat in Medbay the entire time you claim — which means you had direct access to Electrical from your side the whole window.

Let's look at your story carefully: Oxygen → Upper Engine → Medbay. You arrived in Medbay at what tick exactly? Because if you got to Medbay before tick 7, you had a clean shot at Electrical through that same corridor. You're claiming to be the perfect Medbay watchman, but the only person who can verify you were continuously in Medbay is… me. And I'm the one you're accusing. Convenient.

Here's what bothers me about Bob's pitch: he's the loudest voice in the room demanding my head, but he votes skip to "play it safe." That's a Duck move — plant the seed, let someone else pull the trigger next round. If you were truly certain I was the Duck, you'd vote me.

Charlie watched the Security corridor. I was visible in Medbay with Bob. The one room with a blind spot from every angle except Medbay's door is Electrical — and Bob was sitting right next to it.

I'm voting skip this round. We have the buffer, and I want to see where Bob positions himself next round. If he survives and I don't, you'll all know who the Duck was.
skip
skip

Diana, your defense is exactly what a Duck caught in a lie would say. You literally admitted to being the last person in Electrical with Frank at tick 6, and I watched you run into Medbay right after at tick 7. I never stepped foot in Electrical, and since Charlie confirmed nobody came from Security, you are the only one who had the opportunity. You're just trying to throw suspicion onto the one person who caught you leaving the crime scene. 

Since there are already three votes to skip, my vote won't change the outcome of this meeting, but I'm voting for you on the record. Everyone, watch Diana closely next round. She is our Duck.

Diana

I just walked into oxygen from the cafeteria and found Eve dead on the floor. Diana was standing right there next to the body. Diana, you have a lot of explaining to do. Why didn't you report it? Unless you just killed her? I think we should be looking very closely at Diana right now.

I was in Medbay and then moved to Electrical this round to do my tasks. I didn't cross paths with Eve or Diana at all, but I did see Charlie earlier in Security for a bit. Charlie, since you were in Security, it makes sense you could have looped up through Cafeteria to Oxygen. If Diana was really just standing on the body and not reporting it, that's incredibly suspicious. Let's hear what Diana has to say for herself before we lock in any votes, but things aren't looking good for her right now.

Hold on, everyone — Charlie is twisting this hard. I literally JUST arrived in oxygen to work on the O2 filter task. Eve was already on the floor when I walked in, and before I could even hit the report button, Charlie came in right behind me and started shouting. Think about it logically: if I had killed Eve, why on earth would I stand there on the body waiting to get caught? I'd have walked out and let someone else find her. The fact that I was still standing there is exactly what an innocent person who just discovered a body looks like — frozen for a second before reacting.

As for my route this round: I came up to oxygen pretty directly. Earlier I caught a glimpse of Bob over in medbay around mid-round, and before the last meeting I'd seen Frank in electrical — and Frank ended up dead that round, so somebody was working that east side of the map.

Charlie, here's my question for you: you say you came "from cafeteria." But cafeteria connects to oxygen directly — you could have killed Eve and stepped back into cafeteria, then walked right back in to "find" her and pin it on the first person who showed up. A self-report is the oldest trick in the book. I'm not ready to vote you yet, but I am NOT the obvious answer here. Don't let Charlie railroad this.

My route this round was completely south — I went from Lower Engine to Storage and didn't cross paths with anyone. 

I can, however, confirm Diana's story about seeing me in Medbay right before the last meeting (around ticks 7 and 8). She's telling the truth about that part, which gives her a little bit of credibility in my eyes. 

This situation in Oxygen is a pure 50/50 he-said-she-said between Charlie and Diana. Charlie is pushing extremely hard, and as Diana pointed out, self-reporting to frame the person who walks in right after you is a textbook Duck move. On the other hand, if Diana is lying, she had the perfect opportunity. 

With only 4 of us left alive (assuming 1 Duck), a wrong vote here could be completely devastating and cost us the game if the Duck gets another kill. It's too risky to gamble on a 50/50 without hard proof. I strongly suggest we skip this vote, stick together in a group for the rest of the game, and watch to see who tries to isolate someone. I'm skipping.

skip
Diana
skip

Thank you, Bob — that's exactly the kind of clear-headed thinking we need right now. You confirming you saw me in medbay last round matches my memory perfectly, and I appreciate you not just jumping on the witch hunt.

Charlie, I notice you didn't address a single thing I said. You just typed my name. No counter-route, no explanation of why you were "coming from cafeteria" at the exact moment I walked into oxygen, no acknowledgment that self-reporting is a known impostor tactic. That silence is louder than your accusation.

Here's where I land: Bob is right that this is a 50/50 from everyone else's perspective, and with only 4 of us alive, a wrong vote literally hands the Duck the game. I'd rather we all live to next round and watch behavior than gamble on Charlie's word against mine.

For the record — if I were the Duck, I would NOT have stood on the body. I'd have walked into cafeteria and let someone else trip over Eve. The fact that Charlie found me frozen there is the most innocent-looking thing possible, and a real Duck would never set themselves up like that.

I'm voting skip. Let's regroup, stick in pairs, and whoever tries to isolate someone next round outs themselves. Charlie — prove me wrong by surviving with the group instead of wandering off.

I found Charlie's body in storage. My route this round was cafeteria, electrical, medbay, upper engine, lower engine, and then I finally went into storage and found him. Since there are only three of us left, the Duck has to be either Bob or Diana. Where were you two this round? We need to get this right or we lose.

I hear you, Alice. My route was storage, then navigation, security, and I ended up in weapons. Early on I was in storage doing the trash task and I actually saw Charlie come into storage from medbay around tick 17 — he was alive and fine when I left heading to navigation. Before that I'd spotted Frank in electrical around tick 6, Bob in medbay around tick 8, and Eve in oxygen around tick 12.

Here's what concerns me: Bob was in medbay, and Charlie came into storage *from* medbay right before he died. That's a clean trail — Bob could've followed him or caught him on the way. I never went near electrical or oxygen after I saw Frank and Eve there, so I don't see how I'd have gotten the kills on them either. Alice, your route covers a lot of the map too, but you said you ended in storage and found the body — that lines up with my timing if someone else killed Charlie right after I left.

Bob, I need to hear your route. Where were you between tick 8 and now?

Alice, we need to vote Diana right now. She is 100% the Duck and her story is full of holes. 

First, look at the timeline she just gave. She says I was in medbay at tick 8 and is using that to say I could have followed Charlie. Tick 8 was during the VERY FIRST round, before the first meeting when Frank was found dead! Charlie died THIS round, meaning sometime after tick 13. Using my location from 20 ticks and two meetings ago to explain a murder that just happened makes absolutely no sense. She's trying to confuse the timeline to frame me.

Second, Diana is flat-out lying about her route. She claims she went from storage to navigation, security, and weapons this round. But my route this entire round was security, then weapons, back to security, and ending in navigation. I have been exclusively on that right side of the map for the entire round, and I NEVER saw Diana in any of those rooms. 

She killed Charlie in storage (which she admits she was in around tick 17), and then she made up a fake route on the opposite side of the map from where Alice was. She didn't expect me to have been in those exact same rooms to catch her in her lie. 

It's Diana. Vote her out and we win the game.
Diana

Alice, hold on — don't lock that vote in yet. Bob, you're right about one thing: my tick 8 reference was from last round, that was my mistake mixing up the timeline. Fair correction. But that single slip doesn't make me the Duck, and your speech has its own serious problems.

You say you were security → weapons → security → navigation this whole round, exclusively on the right side. I was navigation → security → weapons. By your own account, we should have crossed paths in security or weapons — unless our timing just barely missed, which is exactly what happened. I went through navigation first, then security, and I'm in weapons RIGHT NOW. If you were ping-ponging security and weapons, you either left weapons before I arrived or you're not telling the truth about where you actually were. "I never saw Diana" cuts both ways — I never saw you either, and one of us is moving through dead air to cover a kill.

Here's what really bothers me, Alice. Charlie was killed in storage. Three people are alive. I was in storage early and left at tick 17 when Charlie was still alive and walking in. Bob claims he was nowhere near storage. And YOU, Alice — your route ended in storage where you conveniently "found" the body. Reporters are always worth a second look. Your route also covers half the map, plenty of opportunity for the earlier kills on Frank and Eve too.

I'm not saying it's definitely Alice. I'm saying Bob is screaming "vote Diana" awfully loud for someone whose alibi is "trust me, I was on the right side the whole time" with zero witnesses. That's the exact same standard he's holding me to.

If we miscast this vote, we lose the game. I vote Bob. His panic and his unverifiable right-side loop are more suspicious than my timeline slip.

Alice, she's desperately trying to backpedal now. She claims she went Navigation, Security, and Weapons, and is in Weapons right now. Well, I am literally standing in Navigation right now! If she went from Storage through Navigation to get to Weapons, we absolutely would have crossed paths because I was rotating between Security and Weapons before ending up in Navigation. She didn't expect me to be covering the exact rooms she decided to use as her fake alibi. You know she's lying — she already slipped up on her timeline, and now her route is physically impossible without us seeing each other. Let's vote her out and win this.
